title: Layout debugger overlay
blurb: A canvas draws an article with a table, a row of buttons and editable text, and over it the margin, padding and content box of every element and the baseline of every line. Tap a part to read its numbers. The overlay stays on the picture when the picture is turned and scaled.
question: Can the canvas that draws an element also draw that element's boxes, margins and baselines over it, at any draw transform, without changing the element?
result: In Chromium 157 yes. Client rectangles of a drawn element are bounding boxes after a turned draw, so the page draws the element once at 0, 0 with globalAlpha 0, reads the layout there, then draws it for real. Baselines come from Range rectangles plus the font's ascent and match a probe to 0.5 px.
